common.tagline: Continuous accreditation compliance for healthcare facilities

dashboard.title: Readiness dashboard
dashboard.intro: This dashboard will show compliance by chapter and department, essential safety requirement status, overdue action items and the compliance trend over time.
dashboard.emptyBody: Set up your facility, then run a first self-assessment to see results here.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the link or go back to the readiness dashboard.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password must be at most 128 characters.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.intro: Create your account, then set up your organization and first facility.
signUp.introInvited: Create your account to accept the invitation.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

mfa.title: Set up two-step verification
mfa.requiredIntro: Your role can change access and approve evidence, so it needs a second step at sign-in. You will need an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.optionalIntro: Add a second step at sign-in with an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
mfa.saveBackupCodes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone.
mfa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app

setup.title: Set up your organization
setup.intro: Name your organization and its first facility. You can add departments and invite your team next.
setup.facilityTypeHint: Used later to decide which standards apply.

errors.alreadyMember: You already belong to a facility. Ask its owner to invite you to others.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

invite.summary: You are invited to join {facility} as {role}.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as <bdi>{email}</bdi>. Sign out, then sign in with the invited email.

errors.notFound: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.accepted: This invitation has already been used.
errors.wrongEmail: This invitation is for a different email address.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

people.intro: Invite people to this facility and choose what they can do.
people.forbidden: Only the facility owner and the quality manager can manage people.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.noDepartmentsYet: No departments yet. Department heads need one; departments arrive with facility setup.
invite.departmentHint: Department heads see and act on their own department only.

errors.invalid: Check the email and the role.
errors.unknownDepartment: Choose a department of this facility.

invitation.subject: Invitation to join {facility} on Mustamir
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join {facility} on Mustamir as {role}.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it.
